cohort: The study included 22 pregnancies diagnosed with fetal omphalocele who underwent invasive diagnostic testing between January 2017 and January 2020.
finding: Chromosomal abnormalities, primarily trisomy 13 and 18, were found in 31.8% of omphalocele cases, and even with normal karyotypes, additional structural defects were common, leading to a poor prognosis.
